title: Fourier sparsity bound by depth
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $T$ be a real-valued decision tree on $n$ Boolean coordinates. The number of nonzero vector Fourier coefficients of the function computed by $T$ is at most $4^{\mathrm{depth}(T)}$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued decision tree on $n$ Boolean coordinates
